title: Safety of Toys: Part 1 Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
description: Specifies physical and mechanical safety requirements and testing methods for toys intended for use by children. Covers sharp edges, small parts, chocking hazards, structural strength, and warnings.

title: Safety of Toys: Part 2 Flammability Requirements
description: Specifies categories of flammable materials that are prohibited in all toys and requirements on flammability of certain toys when exposed to a small source of ignition.

title: Safety of Toys: Part 3 Migration of Certain Elements (Heavy Metal Limits)
description: Specifies maximum acceptable levels for the migration of elements such as Lead, Cadmium, Arsenic, Antimony, Barium, Chromium, Mercury, and Selenium from toy materials.

title: Safety of Toys: Part 4 Swings, Slides and Similar Activity Toys for Domestic Use
description: Specifies requirements and test methods for activity toys for domestic family use intended for children under 14 years of age.

title: Safety of Toys: Part 7 Requirements and Test Methods for Finger Paints
description: Specifies requirements for substances and materials used in finger paints for children to protect health against ingestion or skin contact.

title: Safety of Toys: Part 9 Certain Phthalate Esters in Toys and Children's Products
description: Specifies concentration limits for Phthalate Esters (DEHP, DBP, BBP, DINP, DIDP, DNOP) in soft plastic toys and childcare articles.

title: Safety of Electric Toys
description: Specifies electrical safety requirements for toys having at least one function dependent on electricity (batteries, transformer, solar cells).

title: Information Technology Equipment - Safety: Part 1 General Requirements
description: Applies to mains-powered or battery-powered information technology equipment including electrical business equipment and associated equipment.

title: Audio, Video and Similar Electronic Apparatus - Safety Requirements
description: Applies to electronic apparatus designed to be fed from mains supply, supply apparatus, or batteries, intended for receiving, generating, recording, or reproducing audio and video signals.

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances: Part 1 General Requirements
description: Deals with safety of electrical appliances for household and similar purposes, rated voltage not exceeding 250V for single-phase.

title: Safety of Household Electrical Appliances: Electric Irons
description: Deals with safety of electric dry irons and steam irons for household and similar use.

title: Safety of Household Electrical Appliances: Electric Food Mixers, Grinders and Juicers
description: Specifies safety requirements for electric food mixers, liquidizers, grinders, and juicers for household food preparation.

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline Electrolytes: Part 1 Nickel Systems
description: Requirements and tests for safe operation of secondary sealed nickel cells and batteries for portable applications.

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries: Part 2 Lithium Systems for Portable Applications
description: Requirements and tests for safe operation of secondary sealed lithium cells and batteries used in portable electronic equipment.

title: Lamp Controlgear: Particular Requirements for Electronic Controlgear for LED Modules
description: Specifies safety requirements for DC or AC supplied electronic controlgear for LED modules.

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services - Safety Requirements
description: Specifies safety and interchangeability requirements together with test methods for self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting.

title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets for Household and Similar Purposes
description: Applies to plugs and fixed or portable socket-outlets for AC only, with or without earthing contact, rated voltage up to 250V.

title: Textiles - Surgical Face Masks - Specification
description: Specifies requirements for single-use surgical face masks intended to limit transmission of infective agents from staff to patients during surgical procedures and other medical settings.

title: Textiles - High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) Woven Agro Textiles
description: Specifies physical and performance characteristics for synthetic woven fabric nets used in agriculture, horticulture, and shade applications.

title: Textiles - Upholstery Fabrics - Specification
description: Specifies requirements for woven upholstery fabrics used in domestic and contract furniture coverings.

title: Protective Clothing - Clothing to Protect Against Heat and Flame
description: Specifies performance requirements for garments made from flexible materials designed to protect the user's body against heat and flame.

title: Textiles - Sanitary Napkins - Specification
description: Prescribes safety, absorbency, pH value, and microbial limits for disposable sanitary napkins.

title: Textiles - Tensile Properties of Fabrics: Determination of Maximum Force and Elongation
description: Specifies strip procedure for determination of maximum force and elongation at maximum force of textile fabrics.

title: Polyethylene for Safe Use in Contact with Foodstuffs, Pharmaceuticals and Drinking Water
description: Specifies requirements for polyethylene plastic materials (polyethylene resins and compounds) intended for safe use in contact with food, pharmaceuticals, and potable water.

title: Positive List of Constituents of Polyethylene in Contact with Foodstuffs
description: Lists permissible polymers, catalysts, emulsifiers, antioxidants, and processing aids allowed in manufacturing polyethylene for food contact.

title: Polyethylene Terephthalate (PET) Polymers for Safe Use in Contact with Foodstuffs
description: Specifies requirements for Polyethylene Terephthalate (PET) plastics used for holding foodstuffs, pharmaceuticals, and beverages.

title: Determination of Overall Migration of Constituents of Plastics Materials Intended to Come into Contact with Foodstuffs
description: Prescribes methods of analysis for determining overall migration of constituents from plastics materials into liquid food simulants.

title: Positive List of Constituents for Polypropylene (PP) Materials for Safe Use in Contact with Foodstuffs
description: Specifies positive list of monomers, polymers, and additives suitable for manufacturing Polypropylene containers for food contact.

title: Containers for Packaging of Natural Mineral Water and Packaged Drinking Water
description: Specifies requirements for plastic and glass containers used for packing bottled mineral and drinking water.

title: Safety Requirements for Drinking Water Treatment Units
description: Specifies constructional, performance, and safety requirements for household drinking water purifiers.
